data.name: Frank
data.message: I'm heading to O2 filter, Eve.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Frank, I’m heading toward weapons for asteroids.

I reported Diana’s body in medbay.

My route was upper_engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay. I saw Eve a few times: she entered upper_engine from oxygen early, then I saw her in upper_engine around ticks 3 and 4, and later in oxygen around tick 6. I didn’t see anyone else before finding the body.

I’m not hard accusing Eve, but she’s the only person I saw this round, so I’d like to hear her route and everyone else’s routes, especially anyone who was near medbay or cafeteria.

My route was oxygen → upper_engine → back through oxygen → cafeteria → weapons. I never went into medbay and I never saw Diana this round.

I can confirm seeing Frank in upper_engine around ticks 2-3, then I saw him leave upper_engine toward oxygen at tick 4, and I saw him again in oxygen around tick 6. So his route up to oxygen matches what I saw. After that I went cafeteria then weapons, while he says he went cafeteria then medbay, so I can’t confirm the body part.

Right now Frank is the only one I saw too. Since he reported in medbay he had access to the body, but his earlier path checks out with mine. I’d really like to hear Alice, Bob, and Charlie’s routes, especially if anyone was near medbay/cafeteria or saw Diana alive.

I started in medbay, then went medbay → storage → lower_engine → upper_engine. I didn’t see anyone at all this round — no Frank, no Eve, no Bob, no Charlie, and I did not see Diana or a body when I was in medbay.

So if Diana’s body was in medbay, either she died after I left, or it was in a part I didn’t have vision on, but from my perspective medbay was clear when I left. I can’t confirm Frank and Eve’s later cafeteria/medbay/weapons paths since I went the opposite direction.

Right now I don’t have a hard accuse. Frank reporting in medbay means he was there, but Eve confirms his earlier movement. I really need Bob and Charlie’s routes, especially whether either of them went through medbay, storage, or cafeteria.

I started cafeteria, did a quick pass through medbay, then went electrical. I saw Diana alive in electrical around early/mid round — like ticks 3-4 — and she seemed alone there. After that I looped back through medbay and headed upper_engine into oxygen. I didn’t see a body when I passed medbay, and I didn’t see Frank/Eve/Alice on my route.

Alice saying medbay was clear early fits with what I saw, because Diana was definitely alive in electrical after that. Frank and Eve also seem to confirm each other for the upper_engine/oxygen part, at least earlier. So for me the key gap is after Diana left electrical and somehow ended up dead in medbay.

I want Charlie’s route now. If Charlie was near electrical/medbay/cafeteria, that matters a lot.

I don’t have a visual on anyone this round, unfortunately. My route was storage → navigation → security, and I didn’t encounter Alice, Bob, Eve, Frank, or Diana at all. So I can’t directly clear or accuse anyone from what I saw.

Looking at the stories: Frank and Eve partially confirm each other early in upper_engine/oxygen. Alice says medbay was clear when she left early. Bob is the only one claiming to have seen Diana alive in electrical, and he also says he passed through medbay later with no body. Since Diana ended up dead in medbay, that makes Bob’s route really important and also the least confirmed.

Frank could technically be a self-report, but Eve backing his earlier route makes me less suspicious of him than Bob right now. My strongest suspicion is Bob because he places himself near both Diana and medbay, and nobody confirms it. I’d lean Bob, but if people think that’s too thin, skip is safer.

I’ll add my read now that everyone talked.

My report was definitely Diana in medbay. I came from upper_engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay, and the only person I personally saw was Eve. Eve’s sightings of me line up with my route up through oxygen, so I don’t think she’s making that part up.

Alice says medbay was clear early, and Bob says Diana was alive in electrical around ticks 3-4, then Bob also says he passed medbay later and saw no body. Charlie has no visuals.

The main issue for me is Bob: he’s the only one who places Diana alive, he was near electrical and medbay, and nobody confirms him. That doesn’t prove he’s Duck, but it’s the strongest opportunity story we have. I don’t think this is a hard self-report case on me because Eve can confirm a lot of my movement before I found the body.

I’m leaning Bob, but I want everyone to be honest if they think that’s too thin.

My info is the same: I was oxygen → upper_engine → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons. I saw Frank in upper_engine around ticks 2-3, saw him leave toward oxygen at tick 4, and saw him again in oxygen at tick 6. I never went medbay and never saw Diana.

Looking at everyone’s stories, Alice being in medbay early doesn’t seem to fit the kill if Bob really saw Diana alive later in electrical. Charlie has no visuals, so there’s nothing to verify there. Frank could technically self-report, but I can confirm a decent chunk of his movement before medbay, so I’m not leaning that way right now.

Bob is the one piece that stands out: he says he saw Diana alive, he says he passed medbay, and nobody can confirm any of that. That gives him the clearest opportunity in the timeline. It’s not 100%, but I think Bob is the strongest vote from the info we have.

My info hasn’t changed: I started in medbay, left through storage → lower_engine → upper_engine, and I didn’t see anyone or any body when I was in medbay.

Given Bob says he saw Diana alive later in electrical, that makes it very unlikely the kill happened while I was in medbay early. The body being found in medbay means Diana had to move there after electrical, or someone killed her and left her there after Bob’s claimed sighting.

I agree with the current read: Frank and Eve have partial mutual confirmation, Charlie is unconfirmed but also claims a route away from the medbay/electrical area, and Bob is the only one who puts himself near Diana alive and near medbay after. It’s not a guaranteed Duck hit, but Bob has the strongest opportunity and the least confirmed story. I’m leaning Bob too unless someone has a stronger contradiction.

Hold on — I think people are tunneling me off the “I saw Diana alive” part, but that actually matters against the current theory.

I passed through medbay after electrical and Diana was alive there when I went through. I didn’t see a body because there wasn’t a body yet. Then I left toward upper_engine/oxygen. So if Frank later comes from cafeteria into medbay and reports her there, that kill had to happen after I left medbay, not back when I saw her in electrical.

Frank and Eve confirming each other earlier doesn’t clear Frank for the actual medbay moment. Eve says she split to weapons, so nobody confirms Frank going cafeteria → medbay or what happened when he got there. I’m not saying it’s guaranteed self-report, but if you’re voting me because I was “near Diana alive,” that’s backwards — I’m giving the alive timing before the report.

Charlie also has no visuals at all, so I don’t like that he’s getting treated as safer than me just because his route is unconfirmed away from everything. But between the report and the timing, I’m more suspicious of Frank than anyone right now.

I still don’t have any direct sightings — my route was storage → navigation → security, and I didn’t see anyone.

But Bob’s latest clarification makes me more suspicious, not less. First he said he saw Diana alive in electrical and later passed medbay with no body. Now he’s saying he passed medbay after electrical and Diana was alive there when he went through. That puts him with Diana in or near the actual body location, unconfirmed, shortly before Frank reports.

Frank self-report is possible, yes, because Eve doesn’t confirm the final cafeteria → medbay part. But Bob is the only one whose story places him with Diana alive and then also at medbay, and nobody backs any of that up. If Diana was alive in medbay when Bob was there, that’s basically the strongest last-seen-alive information we have.

I think Bob is still the best vote here.
